name: Shrine of the Dormant Flame
summary: Horde shaman climb to the Shrine of the Dormant Flame, atop Durotar’s highest peak northwest of the Valley of Trials. Telf Joolam keeps this secluded sanctuary, where initiates prove their spiritual mastery.

sections.title: A Summit of Trial and Flame
sections.body:
A narrow trail climbs from the Southfury River at the Southfury Watershed’s southwestern edge. At the summit, Durotar’s red cliffs fall away beneath a wide view, and one misstep near the precipice means certain death. Telf Joolam, a solitary hermit, oversees the sacred rites here.

Orc and troll shaman come to answer the Call of Fire. At the shrine’s brazier, they kindle sleeping coals with the ember of a defeated elemental. The trial proves they can commune with fire and respect its destructive spirits.

faq.q: How do you reach the Shrine of the Dormant Flame?
aliases: how to get to shrine of the dormant flame
faq.answer: Begin at the Southfury River, on the southwestern edge of the Southfury Watershed, just northwest of the Valley of Trials. A narrow, winding trail climbs around the peak to the summit.

faq.q: Why is this shrine important to shaman?
faq.answer: The shrine is sacred to Horde shaman learning to understand and command fire. For the Call of Fire, initiates climb to the summit to prepare a ritual draft and kindle the dormant brazier.
Telf Joolam is a solitary troll hermit who keeps the shrine. He guides young shaman through their trials, preparing a fire draught to awaken their spiritual sight and test their resolve.

faq.q: What happens when you kindle the brazier?
faq.answer: After gathering the ritual components and defeating a hostile fire elemental, shaman place its burning ember in the brazier. The offering proves their strength and discipline in taming the volatile spirit of flame.

angles.text: As a young orc or troll shaman, you climb this crag to kindle your spiritual connection with fire and earn your Fire Totem.
Above Durotar, this isolated shrine preserves ancient elemental rites vital to the spiritual heart of the new Horde.
